17 Tenerife hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Prices on this page are per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees; the study's count below uses the before-tax prices of its CSV. The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price).

One snapshot on September 30, 2026 for Nov 4 to Nov 6, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Tenerife hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 30, 2026 snapshot, at 16 of the 18 Tenerife hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 7, the hotel's own site at 3, Barcelo.com at 1, Evendo at 1, Hotels.com at 1, Stayforlong.com at 1, TravelUp at 1 and Tripadvisor.com at 1. These are the Tenerife rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

Taxes and fees at Tenerife hotels

At the 13 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 7% ($13 a night) to the before-tax going rate. At 4 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
